bcl { version "1.0" } # GENERATED by the console from the routing rules (Admin > Rules > Routing rules). # Do not edit by hand: the next change to a routing rule replaces it. module "custom_routing" { version "1" environment "production" # One decision per provider, holding only the rules that name it: a message # is checked against the rules of each candidate, not against all of them. # "placeholder" is never evaluated; a definition must hold one decision, and with # no rules enabled this is it. decision_schema "placeholder" { effects [allow] default allow strategy first_match } decision_table "placeholder" { default allow hit_policy first } @for(r in rules) { ${raw r.open} row "${raw r.id}" { priority ${raw r.table_priority} when { all { provider.id == "${raw r.provider}" @if(r.account != "") { user.id == "${raw r.account}" }@if(r.tenant != "") { user.tenant == "${raw r.tenant}" }@if(r.countries != "") { message.country matches "^(${raw r.countries})$" }@if(r.recipients != "") { message.to matches "^(${raw r.recipients})$" }@if(r.templates != "") { message.template matches "^(${raw r.templates})$" }@if(r.recipient_prefix != "") { message.to matches "^${raw r.recipient_prefix}" }@if(r.recipient_pattern != "") { message.to matches "${raw r.recipient_pattern}" }@if(r.sender_pattern != "") { message.from matches "${raw r.sender_pattern}" }@if(r.content_words != "") { message.text matches "(?i)(${raw r.content_words})" }@if(r.content_pattern != "") { message.text matches "${raw r.content_pattern}" }@if(r.types != "") { message.type matches "^(${raw r.types})$" }@if(r.min_segments > 0) { message.segments >= ${raw r.min_segments} }@if(r.max_segments > 0) { message.segments <= ${raw r.max_segments} } } } then { outcome { decision ${raw r.effect} reason "${raw r.reason}" attributes { code "${raw r.code}" tier "rule" priority ${raw r.score} reserves ${raw r.reserves} rule_id "${raw r.id}" } } } } ${raw r.close}} }
